description: Pins the MYT5 vault.themes envelope — the 0x01 side of the frozen §10.4.1 md.6 protocol_version split, and the KEK-envelope archetype vault.dictionary shares byte-for-byte. The header version byte is 0x01 even though the family is v0.2: it is not AEAD-bound here, so magic + AAD prefix + KEK context carry the domain separation on their own. Nonce is fixed (raw encoder) so the bytes are reproducible. Generated by `cargo test -p protocol --lib emit_vault_themes_v0_2_vectors_for_paste -- --ignored --nocapture`.

cases.description: Seal an opaque themes payload under the v0.2 KEK with a fixed nonce. expected_version_byte_hex pins the 0x01 convention explicitly, so a port cannot satisfy the case by copying bytes without understanding which byte means what.

The same blob opened under the v0.1 expectation must FAIL. This is the case that matters: the v0.1 reader answers an empty map rather than an error on a decode failure (§9.21.4), so a client that routed the wrong generation would otherwise publish emptiness over the user's themes — the silent shape myne-md/myne#436 was an instance of.
